timeline.summary_en: A man of the Diela tribe, bold and shrewd, he gradually took command of tribal armies.

timeline.title: 即可汗

timeline.summary_en: He assumed the imperial title with the Shence era, turning the Khitan confederation into a state.

timeline.title: 灭渤海

timeline.summary_en: He campaigned in person to destroy Balhae, capturing its king and renaming it Eastern Dan.

timeline.title: 太祖崩
timeline.summary: 崩于扶余，述律太后主丧，次子德光继。
timeline.summary_en: He died at Fuyu; Empress Shulü handled the succession and his second son Deguang followed.

timeline.title: 南北面官
timeline.summary: 南北面官制——北面治契丹，南面治汉人，为辽一代制度基石。
timeline.summary_en: The dual administration governed Khitan by northern offices and Chinese by southern ones, the institutional cornerstone of Liao.

bio_md:
# 辽太祖耶律阿保机 · 主要事迹

耶律阿保机（872—926），契丹迭剌部人，是契丹由部落联盟走向国家的关键人物。他逐步统一契丹诸部，唐天祐四年（907）被推为可汗，此后连任三届而不让位，神册元年（916）称帝建元，国号契丹（后改大辽）。

阿保机大量重用汉人，韩延徽等为之定制度、营宫室；他创制契丹大字，设南北面官——北面官治契丹，南面官治汉人，这一双轨体制成为辽朝一代的制度基石。天赞四年（925）亲征渤海国，次年灭之，俘其王大諲撰，改称东丹国，以长子突欲镇之。

天显元年（926）阿保机崩于扶余，述律太后摄政定策，次子耶律德光即位，是为[[liao-tai-zong|辽太宗]]。

bio_parts_en.value:
Yelü Abaoji (872-926) of the Diela tribe of the Khitan was the figure who carried the Khitan from tribal confederation to statehood. Having united the tribes, he was raised to the khagan throne in 907, held the office through successive terms, and in 916 assumed the imperial title with era names, founding the state of Khitan (later renamed Liao).

Abaoji relied heavily on Han advisers such as Han Yanhui, who built his institutions and palaces; he created the Khitan script and established the dual administration - northern offices for the Khitan, southern offices for the Han - the institutional cornerstone of the Liao. In 925 he campaigned against Balhae in person and destroyed it the next year, renaming it Eastern Dan under his eldest son.
